title: Anonymous Letter Dated March 8, 1934, Addressed To West Hongkew Station Reporting Alleged Communist Base

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. & S. B. REGISTRY.
S.2, Special Branch D 5253
REPORT
Date March 23, 1934 / 3 / 23
Subject (in full) Anonymous letter dated March 8, 1934, addressed to West Hongkew
Station reporting alleged communist base
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by J.B.Ru. D.I.

With reference to the attached anonymous letter
addressed to the Chinese Detective Inspector i/c West Hongkew
Station which had been opened in error by D.I. Lok Kung Sung,
Central Station, the following is the result of enquiries made
into this matter by C.D.S.155 and C.D.C.107 of this office :-
The address in question comprises a double Chinese
dwelling house situated at No.18, Lane 185 (Zung Tuh Li 永德里),
Boundary Road, and has been occupied by a brick dealer named
Czar Yeu Sung (榮友生); native of Shaoshing, Chekiang Province,
for the past ten years. The ground portion of the premises
is used as an office by the Hsin Shing (信兴) Stone Grinding
Co., and is in charge of an accountant named Sze (史) who, with
the assistance of two other employees, attend to all business
transactions.
Mr. Czar is about 60 years of age and his son named
Z.K. Czar (榮傳貴) is the General Manager of the Thrift and
Savings Bank Ltd. 16 North Honan Road.
A discreet watch was kept in the vicinity of the
premises for a period of three days commencing from March 19, 1934
but nothing of a suspicious nature was observed. The front door
of the house is usually locked at 7 p.m. and enquiries made
in the neighbourhood show that the Czar family, in addition
to being respectable citizens, are considered to be comparatively
wealthy.
Liu Tsz Shang (劉子香), secretary of the Ningpo Fellow
Provincials Association, 480 Thibet Road, upon being approached,
emphatically denied any knowledge of the missive and stated
that if it had emanated from this source, it would have been
on the association paper and would have borne their official chop,

报告
日期 1934年3月23日 / 3 / 23
主题（全称） 1934年3月8日致虹口西区警署的匿名信，举报所谓共产党据点
呈报人：侦探督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa） 转呈人：J.B.Ru. 侦探督察

关于附上的致虹口西区警署负责华人侦探督察的匿名信，该信被中央警署侦探督察骆公松（Lok Kung Sung）误拆，本办事处华人侦探小队第155号和华人侦探小队第107号对此事进行调查，结果如下：-
所涉地址包括位于界路永德里185弄18号的一栋双开间中式住宅，过去十年由一名叫荣友生（Czar Yeu Sung）的砖商占用；籍贯为浙江省绍兴。该处底层由信兴磨石公司用作办公室，由一名姓史（Sze）的会计师负责，他在另外两名雇员的协助下处理所有业务往来。
荣先生约60岁，其子荣传贵（Z.K. Czar）是河南北路16号 thrift and savings bank ltd.（ thrift and savings bank ltd.，暂译：节俭储蓄银行有限公司）的总经理。
自1934年3月19日起，对该处附近进行了为期三天的秘密监视，但未观察到任何可疑情况。该房屋的前门通常在晚上7点上锁，周边调查显示，荣家不仅是体面的市民，而且被认为比较富裕。
西藏路480号宁波同乡会秘书刘子香（Liu Tsz Shang）在接受问询时，坚决否认知晓此信，并表示如果信件出自该会，会使用同乡会信纸并加盖官方印章，

The postal cancellation chop on the envelope

Translation of an anonymous letter dated March 8, 1934,
addressed to Chinese Detective Inspector, West Hongkew
Station.

To Chinese Detective Inspector,

We beg to inform you that members of the
undersigned association have heard that a communist
organ has been established in the upstair portion of
the Hsin Shing(信兴) Stone Grinding Co., situated
in the Zung Tuh Li(承德里), Boundary Road (opposite
the North Railway Station), and that secret meetings
are held at 7 p.m. daily. Several national traitors
among whom is Za Zeu Kwei(柴傳貴) who is chairman,
Dzung Yien Sz(鄭言如), Sze(施), Woo(胡) and
others form the Standing Committee. They issue
manifestoes derogatory to the Central Government and
instigate unruly elements in the North-West to be
active. They also surreptitiously disseminate
reactionary handbills in various industrial concerns
inducing workers to start labour agitation and disturbing
the public peace. Famel students who arrive in Shanghai
from the North-West to carry on negotiations are well
paid and are despatched to various large hotels to
induce young men to participate in reactionary propaganda.
As this might constitute a serious menace to peace and
good order, we therefore request you to conduct a secret
investigation and make necessary searches.

Signed:- Ningpo Fellow Provincials Association.
March 8.
page_data.zh:
1934年3月8日致虹口西区警署华人侦探督察的匿名信译文。

致华人侦探督察，

谨告知阁下，本会会员获悉，在界路承德里（Zung Tuh Li）（北火车站对面）的信兴磨石公司楼上部分，已建立了一个共产党机关，并且每天下午7时举行秘密会议。几名汉奸组成了常务委员会，其中包括主席柴传贵（Za Zeu Kwei）、郑言如（Dzung Yien Sz）、施（Sze）、胡（Woo）等人。他们发布诋毁中央政府的宣言，并煽动西北地区的不法分子进行活动。他们还暗中在各工业企业散布反动传单，诱使工人发起劳工骚乱，扰乱公共治安。从西北来到上海进行谈判的学生受到优厚酬劳，并被派往各大酒店，诱使年轻人参与反动宣传。鉴于这可能对和平与良好秩序构成严重威胁，因此请阁下进行秘密调查并进行必要的搜查。

签名：- 宁波同乡会。
3月8日。

Shanghai, 17. 3 1934.
To Supt. Clutton.

Sir,
I beg to forward herewith a
letter received and opened
by D.I. Sik King Sung at
Central Station on 17-3-34.
The sender is giving information
regarding alleged communists
who are occupying certain
premises off Boundary Road.

I am Sir
Your obediently
J.King/for C.T
S2
Attention
D.S.I. King

致克拉顿（Clutton）巡官。

先生，
兹转呈一封于1934年3月17日由中央警署侦探督察薛景松（Sik King Sung）收到并拆阅的信件。
发件人提供了关于占据界路附近某些房产的所谓共产党的情报。

此致

J.King/代 C.T
